nodes.label: FAQ Section (native details disclosures)
nodes.rationale: AI answer sets expectations: scope and data sources agreed upfront, tested before launch, may occasionally be wrong so it hands over to the owner when unsure, and small monthly running costs are quoted upfront.

nodes.label: Noscript Notice (JS required for cards and enquiries)
nodes.norm_label: noscript notice (js required for cards and enquiries)

nodes.label: Tailored Quote Pricing Model
nodes.rationale: Every project is quoted individually around goals and budget; scope and price are agreed in writing before work begins.

nodes.label: Business Terms (monthly plan prices, custom quotes, 50% deposit, two revision rounds, VAT)
nodes.norm_label: business terms (monthly plan prices, custom quotes, 50% deposit, two revision rounds, vat)

nodes.norm_label: google fonts stylesheet (dm sans, dm serif display, plus jakarta sans)

nodes.label: Google Fonts with Offline System Font Fallback
nodes.norm_label: google fonts with offline system font fallback

nodes.label: No External JavaScript Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Keeps the site dependency-free so it runs as plain static files with no build step.

nodes.label: Static Enquiry Flow
nodes.rationale: Designed for a static site without a server: hands a prepared message to WhatsApp or the email app for the visitor to send, never stores or transmits data, and never routes to placeholder contacts or falsely claims an enquiry was submitted.

nodes.label: Static Site Deployment (no build, no backend)
nodes.norm_label: static site deployment (no build, no backend)
nodes.rationale: Site is plain static files so it can be opened directly in a browser or uploaded to public_html / any static host without npm, build tools, API keys or a backend.

nodes.label: CONFIG Object (WhatsApp number and email in script.js)
nodes.norm_label: config object (whatsapp number and email in script.js)
nodes.rationale: Contact values are intentionally left blank because the original dummy WhatsApp number and example email (deltech.co.za) were not genuine; either one configured is enough, both recommended.

nodes.label: DelcoTech Software & AI Solutions (brand / trading name)
nodes.norm_label: delcotech software & ai solutions (brand / trading name)

nodes.label: data-bind Content Injection Pattern
nodes.rationale: Static markup holds empty placeholders (subheadline, about, pricingIntro, pricingNote) and empty list containers that are filled from editable content in script.js.

nodes.label: File Responsibility Split (script.js content, style.css design, index.html structure)
nodes.norm_label: file responsibility split (script.js content, style.css design, index.html structure)
nodes.rationale: Editable content, pricing, service descriptions, steps and contact details live in script.js so routine edits do not require touching markup (index.html) or styling (style.css).

nodes.label: DelcoTech Brand Palette (navy #101f29, sky blue #7cc8f6, white)
nodes.norm_label: delcotech brand palette (navy #101f29, sky blue #7cc8f6, white)

nodes.label: C2PA Content Credentials Manifest (Claude-provided provenance)
nodes.rationale: Embedded c2pa:manifest metadata signed by Anthropic Content Credentials, recording that the file was provided/created by Claude at a user's request (AI provenance).

nodes.label: D Monogram Logo Mark (stroked D with dot accent)
nodes.norm_label: d monogram logo mark (stroked d with dot accent)
nodes.rationale: 64x64 rounded-square app-icon style: a heavy rounded-stroke 'D' (for Delco/DelcoTech) on a dark tile with a small white dot at top-right as an accent, giving a compact, legible mark at favicon sizes.
